command: grep -n "nothing to amend\|already matches" docs/cli-reference.md src/cli/*.ts | head -5; grep -n "^## log sync" docs/cli-reference.md; sed -n "$(grep -n '^## log sync' docs/cli-reference.md | cut -d: -f1),+200p" docs/cli-reference.md | grep -niE "APPROVAL.md|dirty|uncommitted|would be overwritten|policy" | cut -c1-240 | head -20
